name: Garden Bulgur
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 medium onion, chopped (or a little less)

steps: Melt margarine in a large skillet; add celery, onion and mushrooms. Stir until vegetables are tender.
Add bulgur and cook until golden.
Add seasonings and broth. Cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.

culture.text: Bulgur or borghol is a cracked wheat foodstuff found in Middle Eastern and South Asian cuisines, among others. It is a cereal food made from the groats of several different wheat species.
